svg.text: A code is a group: pick commuting Pauli strings, and their joint +1 eigenspace is the code
the Steane code [[7,1,3]]: six commuting Pauli strings, one logical qubit, distance 3
g₁ = I I I X X X X
g₂ = I X X I I X X
g₃ = X I X I X I X
g₄ = I I I Z Z Z Z
g₅ = I Z Z I I Z Z
g₆ = Z I Z I Z I Z
three X-type checks
three Z-type checks
(these rows are the
[7,4,3] Hamming parity check)
k = n − (number of independent generators) = 7 − 6 = 1
d = minimum weight of a Pauli that commutes with all generators but is not in the group
e.g. I I Z I Z Z I has weight 3 → d = 3 → corrects ⌊(d−1)/2⌋ = 1 arbitrary error
CSS construction
take classical codes C₂ ⊆ C₁
X-checks from C₁ⁿs parity matrix
Z-checks from C₂ⁿs dual
get [[n, k₁−k₂, d]] quantum code
